samplePoses.imageAlt: Standing tall, feet together, arms at the sides, palms facing forward.
samplePoses.modifications: Stand with feet hip-width apart for more stability, or against a wall to feel alignment.

steps.text: Stand at the top of your mat, feet together or hip-width apart, weight even across both feet.
Engage the thighs, lift the kneecaps gently, and lengthen the tailbone down.
Roll the shoulders back and down, arms relaxed alongside the body, palms facing forward.
Crown of the head reaches upward; soften the face and breathe steadily.

samplePoses.imageAlt: Standing with the torso folded over straight legs, head hanging, hands reaching toward the floor
samplePoses.modifications: Bend the knees generously and rest the hands on blocks or shins.

steps.text: From standing, hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Let the head hang heavy and bend the knees as needed.
Rest hands on the floor, blocks, or opposite elbows.
Release the neck and breathe into the back of the legs.

samplePoses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, legs slightly apart, arms open at the sides, palms up, body fully relaxed
samplePoses.modifications: Place a bolster under the knees and a blanket over the body for warmth.

steps.text: Lie on your back, legs extended, arms a little away from the body, palms up.
Let the feet fall open and the whole body grow heavy.
Soften the face, jaw, and breath.
Rest in stillness, then slowly return when ready.

tile.title: I'm tired
tile.blurb: Supported shapes to rest in when there is nothing left in the tank.

poses.imageAlt: Kneeling with the torso draped over a bolster, hips toward the heels, arms relaxed, forehead supported
poses.modifications: Turn the head to one side, or stack more blankets under the torso for height.

steps.text: Kneel and place a bolster or stack of pillows lengthwise between the knees.
Fold forward and rest the torso and cheek on the support.
Arms can wrap the bolster or rest alongside it.
Soften the jaw and let the breath move the back ribs.
Press into the hands to rise slowly when ready.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the belly, propped on the forearms, chest lifted, legs long, elbows under the shoulders
poses.modifications: Slide the elbows forward to lower the chest, or place a blanket under the hips.

steps.text: Lie face down with the legs extended and the tops of the feet pressing down.
Prop onto the forearms, elbows under or slightly ahead of the shoulders.
Press the pubic bone down and lift the chest forward through the arms.
Roll the shoulders back and soften the gaze slightly forward.
Lower to the mat and turn the head to one side to rest.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back with both calves resting on a chair seat, hips on the floor, arms open at the sides
poses.modifications: Place a folded blanket under the hips, or rest only the heels on the chair seat.

steps.text: Sit beside a chair, then lie back and swing the calves onto the seat.
Adjust so the knees are roughly above the hips, thighs vertical.
Rest the arms by your sides, palms up, and close the eyes.
Stay for several quiet minutes, breathing into the belly.
Bend the knees, roll to one side, and sit up slowly.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, knees bent, feet flat and apart, knees resting toward each other, arms open at the sides
poses.modifications: Tie a soft strap around the thighs so the legs can rest, or place a pillow under the knees.

steps.text: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Let the knees rest toward each other, or keep them upright — whichever feels quieter.
Rest the arms alongside the body or on the belly and heart.
Close the eyes and soften the jaw, forehead, and shoulders.
Stay as long as you like; roll to one side to exit.

tile.title: Before bed
tile.blurb: A long wind-down, ending flat on the floor.

poses.modifications: Turn the head to one side, or stack more blankets under the torso for height.

Fold forward and rest the torso and cheek on the support.
Arms can wrap the bolster or rest alongside it.
Soften the jaw and let the breath move the back ribs.
Press into the hands to rise slowly when ready.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, one knee hugged tightly to the chest, the other leg long on the floor, hands wrapping the shin
poses.modifications: Hold behind the thighs, or hug one knee at a time (Eka Pada Pawanmuktasana).

steps.text: Lie on your back and bend both knees toward the chest.
Wrap the arms around the shins or hold behind the thighs.
Draw the knees in gently on each exhale; keep the head heavy on the floor.
Optionally rock side to side to massage the lower back.
Release the feet to the floor when ready.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, one thigh wrapped over the other, shins hooked, arms open or wrapping, head heavy
poses.modifications: Cross the thighs without wrapping the foot behind the calf.

steps.text: Lie on your back and cross the right thigh over the left.
If available, wrap the right foot behind the left calf.
Draw the legs gently toward the chest, or press the feet into the floor.
Keep the shoulders relaxed and the breath quiet.
Unwind and switch sides.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, thighs crossed, knees stacked, shins folding out, arms resting beside the body
poses.modifications: Keep the bottom foot on the floor, or place a pillow between the knees.

steps.text: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat.
Cross the right knee over the left, stacking the thighs.
Optionally hold the feet or shins and draw the legs in slightly.
Keep the head and shoulders heavy; soften the jaw.
Uncross and switch the stacking order.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, both legs extended to one side, arms open in a T, shoulders grounded, gaze opposite
poses.modifications: Place a bolster between the knees and under the thighs, and keep both shoulders heavy.

steps.text: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms outstretched in a T.
Exhale and guide both knees toward the right, keeping them stacked.
Turn the gaze softly toward the left if comfortable for the neck.
Relax the shoulders into the floor and breathe into the ribs.
Return to center on an inhale, then switch sides.

poses.imageAlt: Lying over a bolster along the spine, chest open, head resting, legs long, arms open at the sides
poses.modifications: Use a lower cushion, or place a rolled blanket under the shoulder blades only.

steps.text: Place a bolster or thick cushion lengthwise on the mat.
Sit just in front of it and recline so the mid-back rests on the support.
Let the head rest on the mat or a thin pillow; arms open to the sides.
Legs can be extended or soles together in a butterfly.
To exit, roll gently to one side and press up.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back with both calves resting on a chair seat, hips on the floor, arms open at the sides
poses.modifications: Place a folded blanket under the hips, or rest only the heels on the chair seat.

steps.text: Sit beside a chair, then lie back and swing the calves onto the seat.
Adjust so the knees are roughly above the hips, thighs vertical.
Rest the arms by your sides, palms up, and close the eyes.
Stay for several quiet minutes, breathing into the belly.
Bend the knees, roll to one side, and sit up slowly.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, knees bent, feet flat and apart, knees resting toward each other, arms open at the sides
poses.modifications: Tie a soft strap around the thighs so the legs can rest, or place a pillow under the knees.

steps.text: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Let the knees rest toward each other, or keep them upright — whichever feels quieter.
Rest the arms alongside the body or on the belly and heart.
Close the eyes and soften the jaw, forehead, and shoulders.
Stay as long as you like; roll to one side to exit.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on one side, knees slightly bent, one arm under the head, the other resting along the body
poses.modifications: Place a pillow between the knees and under the head; hug another pillow to the chest.

steps.text: Lie on your left side with knees softly bent.
Place a pillow under the head and another between the knees.
Rest the arms comfortably — one under the cheek, one in front of the chest.
Close the eyes and let the whole body grow heavy.
Stay as long as you like; switch sides if you wish, or rise slowly.

tile.title: I'm low energy
tile.blurb: Standing shapes to wake the body up without a workout.

poses.imageAlt: Standing tall, feet together, both arms reaching straight overhead, palms facing, gaze slightly up
poses.modifications: Keep a micro-bend in the elbows, or lift only one arm at a time.

steps.text: Stand in Mountain with feet grounded and the spine tall.
Inhale and sweep both arms out and up overhead.
Bring the palms to touch, or keep them shoulder-width apart.
Lift through the side ribs without flaring the lower ribs forward.
Exhale to lower the arms, or fold forward into the next pose.

poses.imageAlt: On all fours, one arm reaching forward, the opposite leg reaching back, both long and level
poses.modifications: Lift only the arm or only the leg, or keep the toes of the lifted leg touching the floor.

steps.text: Come to all fours, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips, spine neutral.
Extend the right arm forward at shoulder height, palm facing in.
Extend the left leg back at hip height, toes pointing down.
Keep the hips level and the gaze down; breathe steadily.
Lower and switch sides — or flow elbow to knee between sides.

poses.imageAlt: Standing tall, feet together, arms at the sides, palms facing forward.
poses.modifications: Stand with feet hip-width apart for more stability, or against a wall to feel alignment.

steps.text: Stand at the top of your mat, feet together or hip-width apart, weight even across both feet.
Engage the thighs, lift the kneecaps gently, and lengthen the tailbone down.
Roll the shoulders back and down, arms relaxed alongside the body, palms facing forward.
Crown of the head reaches upward; soften the face and breathe steadily.

poses.imageAlt: Standing with knees bent, hips back, torso twisting to one side, hands together, elbow outside the thigh
poses.modifications: Sit higher in the chair, keep the hands at the heart, or twist less deeply.

steps.text: Bend the knees into Chair Pose, weight in the heels, arms reaching up.
Bring the palms together at the heart and lengthen the spine.
Exhale and hook the left elbow outside the right thigh.
Press the palms, lift the chest, and keep the knees even.
Unwind to center and repeat on the other side.

poses.imageAlt: In a lunge, hands clasped behind the back, torso folding inside the front thigh, head hanging
poses.modifications: Interlace the hands behind the back without folding fully, or rest the forehead on a block.

steps.text: From Warrior I, interlace the fingers behind the back and broaden the collarbones.
Hinge from the hips and fold the torso inside the front thigh.
Lift the arms away from the back as the crown reaches toward the floor.
Keep the front knee tracking and the back heel grounded.
Hold with steady breath, then rise on an inhale and switch sides.

poses.imageAlt: Standing in a wide lunge, front knee bent, arms stretched to the sides at shoulder height
poses.modifications: Shorten the stance to reduce intensity; rest the back hand on the hip.

steps.text: From a wide stance, turn the right foot out 90° and the left foot in slightly.
Bend the right knee toward 90°, keeping it stacked over the ankle.
Extend the arms parallel to the floor, reaching actively in both directions.
Turn the head to gaze over the front fingertips; sink the hips.
Hold with steady breath, then repeat on the other side.

poses.imageAlt: Standing in a lunge, back foot angled, both arms reaching straight overhead, chest lifted
poses.modifications: Keep hands on hips, or shorten the stance and lift the back heel.

steps.text: Step the left foot back, heel turned down at 45°, hips facing forward.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Sweep the arms overhead, biceps by the ears, palms facing.
Lift the chest, soften the shoulders, and gaze forward or up. Switch sides.

poses.imageAlt: Standing hinged at the hips, torso parallel to the floor, hands on the shins, spine long and flat
poses.modifications: Bend the knees generously and rest the hands on the shins or blocks.

steps.text: From Standing Forward Fold, inhale and lift the chest halfway.
Fingertips on the floor, shins, or blocks — find a long flat back.
Gaze slightly forward of the toes, neck in line with the spine.
Press the thighs back and reach the crown forward.
Exhale to fold again, or step back to Plank.

poses.imageAlt: Kneeling in a lunge, back knee down, front knee bent, arms reaching overhead, chest lifted
poses.modifications: Cushion the back knee with a blanket; keep hands on the front thigh.

steps.text: From Downward Dog, step the right foot forward between the hands.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink the hips forward to feel the front of the back hip open.
Sweep the arms up or rest hands on the front thigh. Switch sides.

poses.imageAlt: Kneeling with hips on the heels, torso folded forward, arms stretched ahead, forehead on the floor
poses.modifications: Widen the knees, rest the forehead on a block, or place a bolster under the torso.

steps.text: Kneel and sit back toward the heels, knees together or wide.
Fold forward and rest the forehead on the floor or a block.
Extend the arms forward or rest them alongside the body.
Soften completely and breathe slowly.

poses.imageAlt: Lying on the back, legs slightly apart, arms open at the sides, palms up, body fully relaxed
poses.modifications: Place a bolster under the knees and a blanket over the body for warmth.

steps.text: Lie on your back, legs extended, arms a little away from the body, palms up.
Let the feet fall open and the whole body grow heavy.
Soften the face, jaw, and breath.
Rest in stillness, then slowly return when ready.
